cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(zen_parquet C)

find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(ZSTD REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET libzstd)
pkg_check_modules(ZLIB REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET zlib)
pkg_check_modules(LZ4 REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET liblz4)
pkg_check_modules(BROTLI REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET libbrotlidec libbrotlienc)

set(CARQUET_ZSTD_TARGET PkgConfig::ZSTD)
set(CARQUET_ZLIB_TARGET PkgConfig::ZLIB)
set(CARQUET_LZ4_TARGET PkgConfig::LZ4)
set(CARQUET_BROTLI_TARGET PkgConfig::BROTLI)
set(CARQUET_BUILD_DEV OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CARQUET_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CARQUET_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CARQUET_BUILD_BENCHMARKS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CARQUET_BUILD_INTEROP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CARQUET_BUILD_CLI OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CARQUET_BUILD_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CARQUET_BUNDLE_DEPS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CARQUET_NATIVE_ARCH OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
# The upstream SSE option also applies SSSE3 to the generic Snappy source.
set(CARQUET_ENABLE_SSE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_DISABLE_FIND_PACKAGE_OpenMP ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FETCHCONTENT_FULLY_DISCONNECTED ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")

if(NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${CARQUET_SOURCE_DIR}/include/carquet")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "CARQUET_SOURCE_DIR must point to the pinned extracted source")
endif()
add_subdirectory("${CARQUET_SOURCE_DIR}" carquet)
